questions.question_text: An administrator must give a guest user access to review Azure resources without creating a new directory account. Which approach should they use?

question_data.scenario: The organization uses Microsoft Entra ID and wants collaborators from partner organizations to sign in with their own identities.
question_data.instructions: Read the scenario, then select the best answer.

options.label: C
options.text: A local admin account on each VM

questions.explanation: Microsoft Entra B2B Collaboration lets external users sign in with their own identity while receiving access in the resource tenant.
